failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Did Janet Krupin perform as a swing in "Next to Normal"? When did Tom Kitt win the Tony Award for "Next to Normal"?

failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1 reasoning, solver states: 'From passage [1]: Tom Kitt won the Tony Award and 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award for "Next to Normal". However, passage [1] states he won the "2010 Pulitzer Prize" (not 2007 Tony), and it mentions he "won the Tony Award and 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award" but doesn't specify the year of the Tony Award.' The passage does not specify the year, but the solver incorrectly treats this as evidence against the claim's 2007 date when passage [2] explicitly states the Tony was won in 2009.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1, solver extensively analyzes passages [3] Paulo Szot, [4] Brian Flemming, [5] Heidi Ettinger, [6] Lynn Ahrens, and [7] Victoria Clark, which discuss various Tony Award winners and musicals unrelated to the claim about Brian Yorkey, Tom Kitt, Janet Krupin, and Next to Normal/If/Then.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query 'Brian Yorkey, Janet Krupin, Next to Normal, If/Then, Tom Kitt, Tony Award 2009, Outer Critics Circle Award 2008' retrieves substantially the same documents as hop 2 (Tom Kitt, Brian Yorkey, Next to Normal passages repeated), with no new information about If/Then musical despite being explicitly requested.
